import json,hashlib,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/sasaki/datasets/openloris/corridor1-1-m8-bounded-native-v1/tier-2500-sparse7n")
old=root
def identities(model):
 out={}
 with (model/"images.txt").open() as stream:
  for line in stream:
   if not line.strip() or line.startswith("#"):continue
   row=line.split(); fields=next(stream).split()
   assert len(row)==10 and len(fields)%3==0 and row[0] not in out
   out[row[0]]=(row[8:],tuple((fields[i],fields[i+1]) for i in range(0,len(fields),3)))
 return out
reference=identities(root/"legacy/model")
out={}
for arm in ("legacy","policy-a","policy-b"):
 model=root/arm/"model"; log=(root/(arm+".log")).read_text();timing=(root/(arm+".time")).read_text()
 assert "Exit status: 0" in timing
 assert identities(model)==reference
 assert (model/"cameras.txt").read_bytes()==(root/"legacy/model/cameras.txt").read_bytes()
 rows=re.findall(r"rig-ba-backend: requested=matrix-free used=([^ ]+) eligibility=eligible iterations=(\d+) accepted=(\d+) pcg_failures=(\d+)",log)
 parts=list(map(float,re.search(r"Elapsed \(wall clock\) time \(h:mm:ss or m:ss\):\s*(\S+)",timing)[1].split(":")));wall=0
 for part in parts:wall=wall*60+part
 out[arm]=dict(wall_seconds=wall,mapper_seconds=float(re.search(r"mapper_seconds=([0-9.]+)",log)[1]),peak_rss_kib=int(re.search(r"Maximum resident set size \(kbytes\):\s*(\d+)",timing)[1]),backend_calls=len(rows),backend_iterations=sum(int(r[1]) for r in rows),accepted_steps=sum(int(r[2]) for r in rows),linear_failures=sum(int(r[3]) for r in rows),zero_accepted_calls=sum(int(r[2])==0 for r in rows),used_backends=sorted(set(r[0] for r in rows)),model_sha256={name:hashlib.sha256((model/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ("cameras.txt","images.txt","points3D.txt")},log=log,time_output=timing)
assert out["policy-a"]["model_sha256"]==out["policy-b"]["model_sha256"]
for arm,previous in [("legacy","legacy"),("policy-a","legacy"),("policy-b","legacy")]:
 for name in ("cameras.txt","images.txt","points3D.txt"):
  assert (root/arm/"model"/name).read_bytes()==(old/previous/"model"/name).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps(dict(runs=out,all_models_exact_to_paired_legacy=True,repeat_model_bytes_exact=True,image_identity_ordered_xy_and_calibration_exact=True)))
